summary: Fixed-tenure tabu memory excludes recent move attributes unless a candidate improves the incumbent record.
description: Input is a nonnegative tenure and an attribute supplied by a search driver. The driver queries permission by iteration and candidate cost, then records an executed move.

Store the last forbidden iteration for each attribute. Admit an otherwise tabu move when it strictly improves the all-time best cost. No neighborhood or route constraints are assumed. Query and update take constant expected time.
